evidence_boundary: No docking-success label, intervention result, hidden simulator state, or environmental force decomposition is included. The goal, delivered odometry-derived pose/motion, declared task tolerance, action result, and exact Nav2 configuration are included.
limitations: This is retrospective development evidence and is not part of the prospective held-out study.
Delivered odometry supports the diagnostic but does not prove every value consumed internally by Nav2.
The diagnosis does not uniquely attribute residual motion to inertia, actuation, wind, current, waves, collision, or model mismatch.
